headline: Funds for three grants will become unencumbered; council could not reallocate them without a State Ethics Commission opinion.
summary: Grantee Anne Thalheimer asked the council to reallocate funds from three grants. Thalheimer declined to contact the State Ethics Commission, citing its past untimely responses. Navae will poll members on November grant-cycle meeting dates, and the treasurer reported $26,005.69 reimbursed of $89,738 for 2026.
decisions: Funds for three grants became unencumbered after the council said it could not reallocate them without a State Ethics Commission opinion.
Approved the treasurer's report on the $89,738 available for 2026.

plain_text:
Holyoke Local Cultural Council 
 August 3, 2026 
 Present: Navae, Tim, Rachel, Mark, Gloria 
 Absent: Chris D., Chris F., Mardelle 
 The meeting began at 6:38 pm. 
 The first order of business was a grantee communication from Anne Thalheimer regarding 
 funding for three grants. Navae informed Anne that, per the MCC, the council would be unable 
 to fulfill her request for reallocation of the funds without an opinion from the State Ethics 
 Commission.  Anne is declining to reach out to the commission due to her previous experience 
 with their untimely responses.  The money from these three grants will now become 
 unencumbered. 
 Navae brought up the issue of meeting minutes. The April and June minutes are missing. Tim 
 will look for them and send them to the cultural council email. 
 Treasurer's Report: Rachel reported that of the $89,738 available for 2026, the council has 
 currently reimbursed $26,005.69.  $60,282.31 is encumbered, and $3450 is unencumbered at 
 present. All approved. 
 The meeting dates for the upcoming grant cycle were proposed as Nov. 2, Nov. 9, Nov. 10, and 
 if needed Nov. 16 or 23rd, 6:30 pm - 9:00 pm. Navae will contact everyone to let them know and 
 determine which dates work best for the majority. It is expected that the panel books will be 
 ready by October 23. 
 No new business reported. 
 The next meeting is set for September 14, location TBA. 
 The meeting adjourned at 7:25 pm.
